title: Sampaati informs Angada about Seetha
introduction: Sampaati informs Angada about Seetha, Ravana, and Lanka after narrating his and his brother Jataayu's flights and plights. Sampaati narrates what he has seen when Seetha was abducted by Ravana and concludes her to be Seetha for she was incessantly calling for Rama's help. He gives an account of the lavish city Lanka as an eagle which has seen that city from this shore of ocean, though he cannot fly as the scorching sun previously burnt both of his wings. Then the returnless monkeys on getting a bare beacon of indication from the lighthouse called Sampaati, they feel highly rejoiced on the seashore.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे अष्ट पंचाशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 58th chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
इति उक्तः करुणम् वाक्यम् वानरैः त्यक्त जीवितैः |
स बाष्पो वानरान् गृध्रः प्रत्युवाच महास्वनः
verses.iast:
iti uktaḥ karuṇam vākyam vānaraiḥ tyakta jīvitaiḥ |
sa bāṣpo vānarān gṛdhraḥ pratyuvāca mahāsvanaḥ
verses.translation: When those monkeys whose lives are almost purged spoke to Sampaati with such dreary words, that thunder-voiced eagle tearfully spoke to those vanara-s.

glosses.meaning: in this way, in dreary, words, one who is spoken to - Sampaati

verses.devanagari:
यवीयान् मम स भ्राता जटायुः नाम वानराः |
यम् आख्यात हतम् युद्धे रावणेन बलीयसा
verses.iast:
yavīyān mama sa bhrātā jaṭāyuḥ nāma vānarāḥ |
yam ākhyāta hatam yuddhe rāvaṇena balīyasā
verses.translation: "Oh, vanara-s, of whom it is enounced that mighty Ravana felled him in a combat, that one is my younger brother named Jatayu...

verses.devanagari:
वृद्ध भावात् अपक्षत्वात् शृण्वन् तत् अपि मर्षये |
न हि मे शक्तिः अद्य अस्ति भ्रातुः वैर विमोक्षणे
verses.iast:
vṛddha bhāvāt apakṣatvāt śṛṇvan tat api mar.hṣaye |
na hi me śaktiḥ adya asti bhrātuḥ vaira vimokṣaṇe
verses.translation: "Even though I hear that my brother is slain I have to resign myself from any activity owing to my oldness and my winglessness, and presently I am indeed incapacitated to retaliate my brother's enemy...

glosses.meaning: to me, now - presnetly I am

verses.devanagari:
पुरा वृत्र वधे वृत्ते स च अहम् च जय एषिणौ |
आदित्यम् उपयातौ स्वो ज्वलंतम् रश्मि मालिनम्
verses.iast:
purā vṛtra vadhe vṛtte sa ca aham ca jaya eṣiṇau |
ādityam upayātau svo jvalaṃtam raśmi mālinam
verses.translation: "Once, when the elimination of demon Vritta was taking place at the hand of Indra, we two eagle-brothers sportively desiring to surpass each other flew sunward, and we have gone very near to the scorch-rayed sun...

glosses.meaning: once, demon Vritta's, elimination, was taking place
we are happening to be - [in historical present tense,] we happened to be - we flew sunward.

verses.devanagari:
आवृत्य आकाश मार्गेण जवेन स्वर् गतौ भृशम् |
मध्यम् प्राप्ते च सूर्ये च जटायुः अवसीदति
verses.iast:
āvṛtya ākāśa mārgeṇa javena svar gatau bhṛśam |
madhyam prāpte ca sūrye ca jaṭāyuḥ avasīdati
verses.translation: "Covering the skyway we have gone to firmament much speedily, then bechanced is noontide and thus bechanced is the scorching of the noontime sun, and then Jataayu started to founder...

glosses.meaning: by sky, way, spreading over - covering [the sky]
with high, speed, to firmament, we have gone

verses.devanagari:
तम् अहम् भ्रातरम् दृष्ट्वा सूर्य रश्मिभिः अर्दितम् |
पक्षाभ्यम् छादयामास स्नेहात् परम विह्वलम्
verses.iast:
tam aham bhrātaram dṛṣṭvā sūrya raśmibhiḥ arditam |
pakṣābhyam chādayāmāsa snehāt parama vihvalam
verses.translation: "On seeing him who is being thwarted by scorching sunrays, then I started to cover my highly fretful brother with both of my wings in all my brotherliness...

glosses.meaning: by sun's, rays, one who is thwarted
by [my] both wings, I started to cover.

verses.devanagari:
निर्दग्ध पत्रः पतितो विन्ध्ये अहम् वानरर्षभाः |
अहम् अस्मिन् वसन् भ्रातुः प्रवृत्तिम् न उपलक्षये
verses.iast:
nirdagdha patraḥ patito vindhye aham vānararṣabhāḥ |
aham asmin vasan bhrātuḥ pravṛttim na upalakṣaye
verses.translation: "And oh, vanara-chiefs, when sunrays have utterly burned my wings I fell down on this Mt. Vindhya, and while living hereabouts constrainedly, I could pay no attention to my brother's experiences or, at least his existence, or otherwise..." So lamented old Sampaati.

glosses.meaning: not, towards, I marked out - I gave no attention.

verses.devanagari:
जटायुषः तु एवम् उक्तो भ्रात्रा सम्पातिना तदा |
युव राजो महाप्राज्ञः प्रत्युवाच अंगदः तदा
verses.iast:
jaṭāyuṣaḥ tu evam ukto bhrātrā sampātinā tadā |
yuva rājo mahāprājñaḥ pratyuvāca aṃgadaḥ tadā
verses.translation: When Sampaati the brother of Jataayu spoke in that way, then the highly discerning crown prince Angada replied him.

glosses.meaning: in that way, he who is spoken - Angada

verses.devanagari:
जटायुषो यदि भ्राता श्रुतम् ते गदितम् मया |
आख्याहि यदि जानासि निलयम् तस्य रक्षसः
verses.iast:
jaṭāyuṣo yadi bhrātā śrutam te gaditam mayā |
ākhyāhi yadi jānāsi nilayam tasya rakṣasaḥ
verses.translation: "If you are the brother of Jataayu, if you have heard whatever I have said in praise of Jataayu, and if you are aware of the whereabouts of Ravana... please tell it...

glosses.meaning: by me, heard - I consider what you have said
of Jataayu, you are brother, if
if, by me, said, by you, heard. That is, 'if you are the brother of Jataayu and if you have heard whatever I have said in praise of Jataayu, you please tell...]

verses.devanagari:
अदीर्घ दर्शिनम् तम् वा रावणम् राक्षसाधिपम् |
अन्तिके यदि वा दूरे यदि जानासि शंस नः
verses.iast:
adīrgha darśinam tam vā rāvaṇam rākṣasādhipam |
antike yadi vā dūre yadi jānāsi śaṃsa naḥ
verses.translation: "If you are aware of the location of that bigoted and knavish demon Ravana, please inform us. Doesn't matter whether that location is nearby or far off as we can search far and wide..." Thus Angada asked Sampaati.

verses.devanagari:
ततो अब्रवीत् महातेजा भ्राता ज्येष्ठो जटायुषः |
आत्म अनुरूपम् वचनम् वानरान् संप्रहर्षयन्
verses.iast:
tato abravīt mahātejā bhrātā jyeṣṭho jaṭāyuṣaḥ |
ātma anurūpam vacanam vānarān sampraharṣayan
verses.translation: Then Sampaati, the high-spirited elder brother of Jataayu, spoke these words that are self-befitting and that would highly gladden the monkeys.

verses.devanagari:
निर्दग्ध पक्षो गृध्रो अहम् गत वीर्यः प्लवम् गमाः |
वाङ् मात्रेण तु रामस्य करिष्ये साह्यम् उत्तमम्
verses.iast:
nirdagdha pakṣo gṛdhro aham gata vīryaḥ plavam gamāḥ |
vāñ mātreṇa tu rāmasya kariṣye sāhyam uttamam
verses.translation: "I am an eagle with utterly burnt wings and vanished valiance, even then, I wish to render a best service in the task of Rama, at least verbally...

glosses.meaning: completely burnt, one having such wings
of Rama [task,] best, service, I wish to render.

verses.devanagari:
जानामि वारुणान् लोकान् विष्णोः त्रैविक्रमान् अपि |
देव असुर विमर्दाम् च हि अमृतस्य च मंथनम्
verses.iast:
jānāmi vāruṇān lokān viṣṇoḥ traivikramān api |
deva asura vimardām ca hi amṛtasya ca maṃthanam
verses.translation: "I have seen the netherworlds of Rain-god viz., earth and its substrata like atala. vitala, sutala, paataala terrains... and I have even seen those empyrean worlds that were triply trodden by Vishnu, and the intermediary regions of upper and lower worlds where gods and demons combated ghastlily, and because I am that aged I have also seen the unseeable Milky Ocean when it was churned for ambrosia...

glosses.meaning: pertaining to triple treading [on all universe]
of Vishnu, even, [about upper worlds - trodden by Vishnu]

verses.devanagari:
रामस्य यत् इदम् कार्यम् कर्तव्यम् प्रथमम् मया |
जरया च हतम् तेजः प्राणाः च शिथिला मम
verses.iast:
rāmasya yat idam kāryam kartavyam prathamam mayā |
jarayā ca hatam tejaḥ prāṇāḥ ca śithilā mama
verses.translation: "It is I who am to render service in this task of Rama firstly, than you vanara-s, as the common enemy of Rama and Jataayu is my first enemy, but I am decrepit as oldness has marred my vigour and vitality...

glosses.meaning: Rama's, that which, this, task - is there, that one is
by me, firstly, to be done
by oldness, my, vigour is, marred

verses.devanagari:
तरुणी रूप संपन्ना सर्व आभरण भूषिता |
ह्रियमाणा मया दृष्टा रावणेन दुरात्मना
क्रोशन्ती राम राम इति लक्ष्मण इति च भामिनी |
भूषणानि अपविध्यन्ती गात्राणि च विधुन्वती
verses.iast:
taruṇī rūpa sampannā sarva ābharaṇa bhūṣitā |
hriyamāṇā mayā dṛṣṭā rāvaṇena durātmanā
krośantī rāma rāma iti lakṣmaṇa iti ca bhāminī |
bhūṣaṇāni apavidhyantī gātrāṇi ca vidhunvatī
verses.translation: "I have seen a youngish lady while she is being stolen away by the black-hearted demon Ravana. She richly in her mien, embellished with every befitting jewellery for a princess, and that lady in fury was bewailing calling, 'Rama... Rama...' even calling 'Lakshmana...' and she was throwing her ornaments down and her limbs were highly wriggly to set herself free from that demon...

verses.devanagari:
सूर्य प्रभा इव शैल अग्रे तस्याः कौशेयम् उत्तमम् |
असिते राक्षसे भाति यथा वा तडित् अंबुदे
verses.iast:
sūrya prabhā iva śaila agre tasyāḥ kauśeyam uttamam |
asite rākṣase bhāti yathā vā taḍit ambude
verses.translation: "In the flank of that blackish demon her best ochry silk-sari was dazzling like sunshine atop a blackish mountain, or like lighting athwart a blackish ocean...
notes: Thus expression ambude taḍit yathā is also said as vidyut iva ambare - vidyut iva ambude in other mms, meaning 'lightning with a backdrop of blue-black sky or ocean...'

glosses.meaning: [in blakish,] in waters [of ocean,] lightning, as with

verses.devanagari:
ताम् तु सीताम् अहम् मन्ये रामस्य परिकीर्तनात् |
श्रूयताम् मे कथयतो निलयम् तस्य रक्षसः
verses.iast:
tām tu sītām aham manye rāmasya parikīrtanāt |
śrūyatām me kathayato nilayam tasya rakṣasaḥ
verses.translation: "Thus, I deem her to be Seetha by her excessive laudation of Rama, and let the location of that demon be heard from me while I say about it...

glosses.meaning: her, on her part, as Seetha, I, deem

verses.devanagari:
पुत्रो विश्रवसः साक्षात् भ्राता वैश्रवणस्य च |
अध्यास्ते नगरीम् लंकाम् रावणो नाम राक्षसः
verses.iast:
putro viśravasaḥ sākṣāt bhrātā vaiśravaṇasya ca |
adhyāste nagarīm laṃkām rāvaṇo nāma rākśasaḥ
verses.translation: "Literally, he is the son of Vishravasa and brother of Kubera, and he presides over the city named Lanka and he is known as Ravana...
notes: Here the style of Valmiki is extolled. Jataayu tells the very same first foot of this verse in Aranya Kanda, and when he was about to say this verse's second foot, he dies. It will be like this in Aranya Kanda at 3-68-16: putro viśravasaḥ sākśāt bhratā vaiśravaṇasya ca | iti uktvā durlabhān prāṇān mumoca patageśvara || And if Jataayu would have said the second foot as above, stating that 'he is Ravana and he is Lanka...' there would be no Kishkindha canto, nor Vali, nor Sugreeva, nor even Hanuma, and his Sundara Kanda, as Rama would have gone to Lanka, straightaway. Ramayana is still living as great literary work because it has this kind of melodramatic montages on very many occasions. The family tree of Ravana is given in the endnote.

verses.devanagari:
इतो द्वीपे समुद्रस्य संपूर्णे शत योजने |
तस्मिन् लंका पुरी रम्या निर्मिता विश्वकर्मणा
verses.iast:
ito dvīpe samudrasya sampūrṇe śata yojane |
tasmin laṃkā purī ramyā nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā
verses.translation: "There is a lavish city in the oceanic island afar a hundred yojana-s all in all from here, which Vishvakarma, the Divine-Architect, has built, and it is called Lanka.

glosses.meaning: all in all, hundred, yojana-s - in distance
in oceanic, island [an island - is there]

verses.devanagari:
जांबूनदमयैः द्वारैः चित्रैः कांचन वेदिकैः |
प्रासादैः हेम वर्णैः च महद्भिः सुसमाकृता
प्राकारेण अर्क वर्णेन महता च समन्विता |
verses.iast:
jāmbūnadamayaiḥ dvāraiḥ citraiḥ kāṃcana vedikaiḥ |
prāsādaiḥ hema varṇaiḥ ca mahadbhiḥ susamākṛtā
prākāreṇa arka varṇena mahatā ca samanvitā |
verses.translation: "Its multi-storied buildings are built very symmetrically and they will be in golden tinge with completely golden doors. The golden podia of verandas are amazing. That city is securely enclosed in a gigantic rampart that will be dazzling in the colour of sun...

glosses.meaning: with sun, coloured - dazzling like sun

verses.devanagari:
तस्याम् वसति वैदेही दीना कौशेय वासिनी
रावण अन्तःपुरे रुद्धा राक्षसीभिः सुरक्षिता |
जनकस्य आत्मजाम् राज्ञः तस्याम् द्रक्ष्यथ मैथिलीम्
verses.iast:
tasyām vasati vaidehī dīnā kauśeya vāsinī
rāvaṇa antaḥpure ruddhā rākṣasībhiḥ surakṣitā |
janakasya ātmajām rājñaḥ tasyām drakṣyatha maithilīm
verses.translation: "Therein that Lanka pitiable Vaidehi wearing ochry silk sari is lodged in the palace-chambers of Ravana, highly sentineled and baulked by demonesses, and you can find king Janaka's daughter Maithili in there...
notes: The ochry silk sari is for continuity reasons. As there were no continuity girls or continuity men, [namely, the persons responsible for agreement of detail between different sessions of filming,] the poet himself became one and repeats this 'gold-yellow-red coloured silk sari of Seetha...' oft times.

verses.devanagari:
लंकायाम् अथ गुप्तायाम् सागरेण समंततः |
संप्राप्य सागरस्य अंतम् संपूर्णम् शत योजनम्
आसाद्य दक्षिणम् तीरम् ततो द्रक्ष्यथ रावणम् |
तत्र एव त्वरिताः क्षिप्रम् विक्रमध्वम् प्लवंगमाः
verses.iast:
laṃkāyām atha guptāyām sāgareṇa samaṃtataḥ |
samprāpya sāgarasya aṃtam sampūrṇam śata yojanam
āsādya dakṣiṇam tīram tato drakṣyatha rāvaṇam |
tatra eva tvaritāḥ kṣipram vikramadhvam plavaṅgamāḥ
verses.translation: "Now, oh, fly-jumpers, first get to the other shore of the island in southern ocean, which ocean spans in an overalled width of hundred yojana-s from this side of seashore, then landing on the other seashore you can see Lanka secluded all around by ocean, and in such a water-walled Lanka you can see Ravana... hence, hurry up, and promptly triumph over Lanka...

glosses.meaning: ocean's, end, [northern end of southern ocean - northern shoreline of island] on reaching
southerly, shore [northern seashore of southerly island, Lanka,] on getting at
by ocean, secluded, in [such water-walled] Lanka

verses.devanagari:
ज्ञानेन खलु पश्यामि दृष्ट्वा प्रत्यागमिष्यथ |
आद्यः पंथाः कुलिंगानाम् ये च अन्ये धान्य जीविनः
द्वितीयो बलि भोजानाम् ये च वृक्ष फल अशिनः |
भासाः तृतीयम् गच्छन्ति क्रौन्चाः च कुररैः सह
श्येनाः चतुर्थम् गच्छन्ति गृध्रा गच्छन्ति पंचमम् |
verses.iast:
jñānena khalu paśyāmi dṛṣṭvā pratyāgamiṣyatha |
ādyaḥ paṃthāḥ kuliṃgānām ye ca anye dhānya jīvinaḥ
dvitīyo bali bhojānām ye ca vṛkṣa phala aśinaḥ |
bhāsāḥ tṛtīyam gacchanti krauncāḥ ca kuraraiḥ saha
śyenāḥ caturtham gacchanti gṛdhrā gacchanti paṃcamam |
verses.translation: "I foresee by my prognosis that your sighting Seetha is definite at that place, and definite is your return from there. The first flight level of birds is that of the small Kulinga birds, house sparrows, songbirds and the like subsisting on food-grains. The second flight level is that of the birds that are the eaters of leftovers like crows and doves, or the eaters of tree-fruits like parrots. The third flight level is that of the wading birds like Bhaasa, Kraunca, Kurara birds and cranes, herons and the like. The fourth flight level is that of hawks and the fifth is that of the vultures.

glosses.meaning: on [your] seeing [Seetha,] in turn [from there,] you will come back [return]
other [similar birds,] on food-grains, which live on grain
which - birds are there, for them
first, [in sky they fly in] path - level of flight
leftovers, for the eaters of [like crows etc which eat leftovers]
for tree, fruits, eaters - like parrots etc
in third [flight path,] they will be going
vultures, in fifth [flight path,] will be flying.

verses.devanagari:
बल वीर्य उपपन्नानाम् रूप यौवन शालिनाम्
षष्ठः तु पन्था हंसानाम् वैनतेय गतिः परा |
वैनतेयात् च नः जन्म सर्वेषाम् वानरर्षभाः
verses.iast:
bala vīrya upapannānām rūpa yauvana śālinām
ṣaṣṭhaḥ tu panthā haṃsānām vainateya gatiḥ parā |
vainateyāt ca naḥ janma sarveṣām vānararṣabhāḥ
verses.translation: "And the sixth flight level is that of the swans which derive their valour, vigour, handsomeness and youthfulness by their majestic birth. But the uppermost path is that of the sons of Lady Vinata, namely the Divine Eagle Garuda, and Anuuru, the non-stopping charioteer of Sun. Because we eagles have our lineal descent from the Divine Eagle, we can soar to the uppermost flyable path and see keenly...
notes: Lady Vinata's account is available in Aranya canto 14, where Jataayu gives accounts of procreation of birds. Anuuru and Garuda are two bird-sons of Vinata. Garuda is the eagle-vehicle of God Vishnu, while Aruna, also called Anuuru, an+ūruḥ 'without, thighs - thigh-less being...' is the charioteer of Sun's seven-horse chariot. Further, Sun rides a single-wheeled chariot!?
Some quoting yajur vedasay, that the chariot of Sun is not drwan by any seven horses, and the word sapta - in sapta ashva samArUDham etc is the name of only one horse drawing the chariot of Sun.

However, the seven horses of Sun's chariot are generally taken the seven - vibgyor - colours of light as in a rainbow. Aruna, the Colour of Dawn, is another aspect of Anuuru that appears before the advent of the Sun himself. These two are of avian origination and attributed to be the speediest propellers. And Jataayu and Sampaati, for that matter of fact, all eagles belong to that lineage, for their keen vision and powerful flight.

glosses.meaning: of Vianata's sons [one Garuda, other Anuuru]

verses.devanagari:
गर्हितम् तु कृतम् कर्म येन स्म पिशित अशनाः |
प्रतिकार्यम् च मे तस्य वैरम् भ्रातृ कृतम् भवेत्
verses.iast:
garhitam tu kṛtam karma yena sma piśita aśanāḥ |
pratikāryam ca me tasya vairam bhrātṛ kṛtam bhavet
verses.translation: "By which raw-flesh-eating demon this deplorable deed of abducting Seetha is done, if that demon is retaliated by Rama and you all, my vendetta towards the very same demon, caused by his animosity towards my brother Jataayu will also be fulfilled...

glosses.meaning: in respect of [my] brother, caused, animosity/vendetta

verses.devanagari:
इह स्थः अहम् प्रपश्यामि रावणम् जानकीम् तथा |
अस्माकम् अपि सौपर्णम् दिव्यम् चक्षुर् बलम् तथा
verses.iast:
iha sthaḥ aham prapaśyāmi rāvaṇam jānakīm tathā |
asmākam api sauparṇam divyam cakṣur balam tathā
verses.translation: "Staying here I am clearly seeing Ravana and like that Janaki... even for us eagles, our sight and power will be excellent like that of Garuda, the Divine Eagle...

glosses.meaning: at Ravana, like that, at Janaki
belonging to Suparna, namely Garuda, the Divine Eagle
like that, power - we too have them.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मात् आहार वीर्येण निसर्गेण च वानराः |
आयोजन शतात् साग्रात् वयम् पश्याम नित्यशः
verses.iast:
tasmāt āhāra vīryeṇa nisargeṇa ca vānarāḥ |
āyojana śatāt sāgrāt vayam paśyāma nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: "Thereby, oh, vanara-s, dietetically and congenitally we eagles can always see till the end of hundred yojana-s, comprehensively...
notes: The expression 'dietetically and lineally' indicates as to why eagle always prefers fresh meat unlike vultures subsisting on carrion. It is only for the enrichment of their sight, might and flight.

atra āhāra vireyaṇa iti uktyā māmsa viśeśa bhakṣaṇa śīlānām gṛdhrāṇām cakṣuśya māmsa bhakṣaṇena dūra darśana sāmardhyam uktam | nisargeṇa iti viśeṣaṇena ca jāti svabhāvyāt api dūra darśitam uktam | tadā api vaidya nighaṇṭo - dāskhasye dūra druma agre vajra cuncu su dṛṣṭikaḥ - iti | ca kāreṇa anirodhena vātiviṇmūtrādi utsargādikam cakṣuṣyam iti ukatam - dkThus, the innate, fixed, pattern of behaviour in kingly eagles is recorded in response to certain stimuli.

glosses.meaning: food, by the might of [dietetically mighty]

verses.devanagari:
अस्माकम् विहिता वृत्तिः निसार्गेण च दूरतः |
विहिता पाद मूले तु वृत्तिः चरण योधिनाम्
verses.iast:
asmākam vihitā vṛttiḥ nisārgeṇa ca dūrataḥ |
vihitā pāda mūle tu vṛttiḥ caraṇa yodhinām
verses.translation: "The leg-fighters, namely cocks, are destined to have their livelihood just at the base of their feet, but our livelihood is to be obtained from the farthest... alas...
notes: For living beings if one thing is on plus's side, just at its back a minus point will also be there, like a night after day, sorrow after rejoice. Eagles may see long or fly high, but food for them is a rarity. Here Sampaati is self-piteous, as his son has not yet arrived bringing food for that day.

glosses.meaning: for legs, fighters [cocks, fighters with legs in cockfights]

verses.devanagari:
उपायो दृश्यताम् कश्चित् लंघने लवण अंभसः |
अभिगम्य तु वैदेहीम् समृद्ध अर्था गमिष्यथ
verses.iast:
upāyo dṛśyatām kaścit laṃghane lavaṇa ambhasaḥ |
abhigamya tu vaidehīm samṛddha arthā gamiṣyatha
verses.translation: "Let some idea be searched to leap the salty ocean. For sure, you will return to Kishkindha on your finding Vaidehi, and on your becoming productive of you objective...

glosses.meaning: some, idea, may be looked over

verses.devanagari:
समुद्रम् नेतुम् इच्छामि भवद्भिः वरुण आलयम् |
प्रदास्यामि उदकम् भ्रातुः स्वर् गतस्य महात्मनः
verses.iast:
samudram netum icchāmi bhavadbhiḥ varuṇa ālayam |
pradāsyāmi udakam bhrātuḥ svar gatasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "I wish you would shift me to the residence of Rain-god, namely the ocean, for oblating water in respect of my great-souled brother Jataayu who departed to heaven..." Thus Sampaati spoke to the monkeys.

glosses.meaning: to ocean, to reach, I wish to
to heaven, one who has gone, great-souled one, for brother

verses.devanagari:
ततो नीत्वा तु तम् देशम् तीरे नद नदी पतेः |
निर्दग्ध पक्षम् संपातिम् वानराः सुमहौओजसः
तम् पुनः प्रत्यानयित्वा वै तम् देशम् पतग ईश्वरम् |
बभूवुः वानरा हृष्टाः प्रवृत्तिम् उपलभ्य ते
verses.iast:
tato nītvā tu tam deśam tīre nada nadī pateḥ |
nirdagdha pakṣam sampātim vānarāḥ sumahauojasaḥ
tam punaḥ pratyānayitvā vai tam deśam pataga īśvaram |
babhūvuḥ vānarā hṛṣṭāḥ pravṛttim upalabhya te
verses.translation: Then those vanara-s of utmost dynamism on taking wing-burnt-bird Sampaati to the husband rivulets and rivers, namely the ocean, placed him on the shoreline. Again, the vanara-s sincerely brought back that king of birds, Sampaati, after his offering oblations to Jataayu, and lodged him as a returnee at his own place. On deriving indication form Sampaati regarding Seetha, Ravana and Lanka, those returnless vanara-s returned to their search while their gladness returning to them.

glosses.meaning: of rivulets, rivers, husband of - ocean
